note.p: All ticket actions are logged automatically to preserve auditability and operational traceability. Users should ensure that updates accurately reflect performed work.
Incident priority must reflect actual business impact. Incorrect classification may delay resolution or misallocate resources.
When resolving recurring incidents, technicians are encouraged to document findings in the knowledge base to support future resolution efficiency.
Ticket status should always match the current operational state. Delayed updates can affect reporting accuracy and workflow coordination.
